status: DRAFT_FOR_DEV_ONLY (never activates a forward window, never opens validation, locked, paper or IW1 data)
data_state_when_written: no data for these signals downloaded or computed in this session; the broad-universe archive from ADR 0035/0038 is NOT on disk here and is downloaded only after this file is committed
requested_by: 동동, 2026-10-27 '3개다 진행' (coordinator: preregister 3-5 new economically motivated hypotheses that use the measured alt cost of ADR 0038; avoid the ADR 0035 four and the BTC/ETH rule space; multivariate cross-section / structural; low turnover; 30-100 symbols)
question: On a point-in-time top-50 universe of Binance USDT-M perpetuals, does any of five new cross-sectional hypotheses with a published economic story earn a positive, beta-adjusted return after the measured alt cost, on DEV data only?
what_the_author_had_already_seen: ADR 0035/0038 results for MOM28, REV7, CARRY7, LOWVOL30 on the same universe and segments (all NOT_PROMISING). None of those four signals is reused. N3_MAX is economically related to LOWVOL30 (lottery demand vs low-vol anomaly) and is expected to correlate with it; this is disclosed, not hidden. No result of N1-N5 has been seen.
scope: DEV only. No validation, locked, paper or IW1 window. No criteria change, no prereg v2/v3 change. Results are research notes; a DEV_PROMISING flag can only lead to a proposal of a NEW preregistered forward window, which needs the user's explicit go.

universe.source: every USDT-quoted symbol under data/futures/um/monthly/klines/ of the public Binance archive (S3 mirror), including symbols delisted later (no survivorship filter); same listing rule and exclusions as prereg_broad_universe_v1.json
universe.point_in_time_rule: at each rebalance: symbols with at least 60 complete daily bars before the signal cut-off and a bar at the rebalance open, ranked by mean daily quote volume over the 30 days to the cut-off; keep the top 50 (identical to ADR 0035, so the measured cost and the earlier universe stay comparable)
universe.segment_rule: BTCUSDT is not read in S2 (ADR 0019); every symbol obeys never_read

S1.use: the only segment that decides anything

S2.use: reported, and used only in the fixed S2 > 0.5 condition of the flag

never_read: BTC validation/locked TEST + embargo, all symbols
timing: rebalance on the first Monday on/after first_rebalance_from and then every 28 days (every 4th Monday) at the 00:00 UTC daily open. Signals use daily bars that closed by Sunday 00:00 UTC (one day skipped). Positions are held 28 days.
portfolio: long 10 and short 10 of the 50 by the hypothesis signal, equal target weight +-1/20 of capital (gross 1, net 0), ties broken by symbol name. Between rebalances weights drift with each name's return (buy and hold, no free daily rebalancing); at a rebalance the traded amount is |target - drifted weight|.
missing_data: never filled. A held name with no daily bar earns 0 that day and is closed at the next rebalance. Counted and reported. Report also the number of held names whose data end inside a holding period and never resume in the segment (possible delistings) split by long/short side.

hypotheses.story: size / illiquidity premium: small, less liquid coins earn a premium for illiquidity and limited arbitrage (Liu, Tsyvinski & Wu 2022, J. Finance, 'Common Risk Factors in Cryptocurrency', size factor)
hypotheses.signal: mean daily quote volume over the 30 days to the cut-off (market cap is not in the data; trading volume is the size proxy)

hypotheses.story: high-volume return premium / attention: an abnormal rise in trading volume raises visibility and is followed by higher returns (Gervais, Kaniel & Mingelgrin 2001, J. Finance; volume factors in Liu, Tsyvinski & Wu 2022)
hypotheses.signal: log(mean daily quote volume of the last 7 days to the cut-off / mean daily quote volume of the 53 days before those 7)

hypotheses.story: lottery demand: coins with extreme recent daily gains are overpriced by lottery-seeking traders and underperform (Bali, Cakici & Whitelaw 2011, J. Financial Economics; crypto: Grobys & Junttila 2021, Int. Review of Financial Analysis)
hypotheses.signal: maximum close-to-close daily return over the 28 days to the cut-off (needs 28 returns)

hypotheses.story: order imbalance: persistent aggressive (taker) buying reflects informed demand and predicts returns over the next weeks (Chordia & Subrahmanyam 2004, J. Financial Economics). Direction fixed a priori to the informed-flow reading; the opposite (price-pressure reversal) reading is NOT tested
hypotheses.signal: sum of taker-buy quote volume / sum of quote volume over the 28 days to the cut-off (daily kline columns 11 and 8)

hypotheses.story: multivariate: the four characteristics above are partly independent, so an equal-weight combination should diversify their noise (multi-characteristic sorts, e.g. Liu, Tsyvinski & Wu 2022)
hypotheses.signal: mean of the four cross-sectional percentile ranks within the 50, each oriented so that high = long side of N1-N4; a name missing any of the four signals is dropped for N5

trials: exactly these 5, each run once, with exactly the settings above. Recorded as 5 DEV evaluations in run/audit/dev_search_trials.jsonl. Any change of universe size, holding period, side size, lookback or direction afterwards is a NEW trial with a new prereg and ADR.

cost.decides: measured alt cost record run/audit/alt_cost_measured_20261027/estimate_v3_alts.json (PE-ed757f47..., ESTIMATED_FROM_PUBLIC_DATA): per side fee 5bp + half spread 7.27bp + 0.0015*sqrt(10,000 USDT / quote volume of the 23:45-00:00 UTC 15m bar before the Monday open), charged on every traded weight with an order value of 10,000 USDT per name
cost.impact_bar: as ADR 0035: if the 23:45 bar is missing, the day's quote volume / 96 is used and counted
cost.funding: actual settled funding on every held (drifted) position; a short receives positive funding

rows.measured_x2: must stay positive (robustness against the measured cost being optimistic for the smaller names)

cost.known_limit: measured on 7 liquid alts; the smaller names of the top 50 may cost more, hence the x2 row in the flag

statistics.unit: daily portfolio return on constant capital 1, simple sum
statistics.report: annualised Sharpe, annual return, max drawdown, t of mean, beta and correlation to the equal-weight universe, beta-adjusted mean and its t, S1 halves, S2, every cost row, turnover per rebalance, cost share, pairwise correlation of the five daily S1 series
statistics.dev_flag_not_a_verdict: DEV_PROMISING only if, under the measured cost: (a) S1 annual Sharpe above the expected maximum of 5 unskilled trials over the S1 length (Bailey et al. 2014, engine_lib.expected_max_sr), (b) S1 beta-adjusted mean t >= 2, (c) both S1 halves positive, (d) S2 annual Sharpe > 0.5, and (e) S1 annual Sharpe under measured_x2 cost > 0. Anything else is NOT_PROMISING. The flag never opens a window.
statistics.power_note: S1 is about 2.5 years; the 80% power horizon for annual SR 1 at alpha 0.03 is about 7 years (STRATEGY_SEARCH_REVIEW_20261023), so a true SR-1 effect will most likely be flagged NOT_PROMISING. That is accepted and stated in advance.
